description: All URLs a website lists in its XML sitemaps (from robots.txt, /sitemap.xml or /sitemap_index.xml, following indexes), with lastmod, newest first. Filter by path prefix and changed-since date. For agents that need a site's page list before reading pages. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

pathPrefix.description: Only URLs whose path starts with this, e.g. /blog/

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only URLs with lastmod on or after it

name: sitemap
title: Sitemap
